2607.04728.title: Turning Off-Policy Tokens On-Policy: A Plug-in Approach for Improving LLM Alignment
2607.04728.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for large language models (LLMs) follows a efficient paradigm of "rollout then update", which inevitably results in off-policy training data. To resolve this, Importance sampling (IS) is proposed, while the token-level ratios compound over long sequences, causing severe variance exploded. A natural idea is "transferring" these off-policy token into on-policy token, so that the importance scores for correction are unnecessary. Following this idea, we propose Selective Importance Sampling (SIS), which is inspired by rejection sampling. Concretely, SIS implements by viewing off-policy model as proposal distribution, and implement a token-level rejection test: accepted tokens are viewed as on-policy, so that receive unit importance score, while rejected tokens retain the standard IS correction. Our proposed SIS is theoretically proved reducing the gap between token-level and sequence-level off-policy gradient estimators. The SIS acts as a plug-in that only modifies the importance ratio in the policy loss, adding negligible wall-clock overhead, and can be combine with a vast vary of RL post-training algorithms. Experiments on dense and MoE LLMs across math and agent benchmarks show that SIS consistently improves all objectives, while providing substantially stronger robustness under off-policy data.
2607.04728.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習（RL）對大型語言模型（LLMs）的後訓練遵循一種高效的「先展開再更新」的範式，這不可避免地導致了非政策訓練數據。為了解決這個問題，提出了重要性抽樣（IS），但隨著長序列中令牌級別的比率累積，導致了嚴重的方差爆炸。一個自然的想法是將這些非政策令牌「轉換」為政策令牌，這樣就不需要進行重要性分數的修正。基於這一想法，我們提出了選擇性重要性抽樣（SIS），其靈感來自拒絕抽樣。具體來說，SIS 通過將非政策模型視為提議分佈來實現，並實施令牌級別的拒絕測試：被接受的令牌被視為政策令牌，因此獲得單位重要性分數，而被拒絕的令牌則保留標準的 IS 修正。我們提出的 SIS 在理論上證明了減少令牌級別和序列級別非政策梯度估計器之間的差距。SIS 作為一個插件，只修改政策損失中的重要性比率，增加的牆鐘開銷微不足道，並且可以與各種 RL 後訓練算法結合使用。在數學和代理基準上的密集型和 MoE LLM 實驗顯示，SIS 始終改善所有目標，同時在非政策數據下提供了顯著更強的穩健性。
